name: 艾提尕尔清真寺
Id Kah Mosque
introduction: 清真寺的门楼面对广场，院落从老城的街道向里展开。
The gateway faces a square in Kashgar’s old town, with the prayer courtyard beyond.

name: 阿巴和加麻札
Afaq Khoja Mausoleum
introduction: 喀什城外，陵园的穹顶覆着彩色琉璃。
Glazed tiles cover the domes of this family mausoleum outside Kashgar.

name: 莫尔寺遗址
Mor Buddhist site
introduction: 两座夯土佛塔标出古寺在荒原上的位置。
Two earthen towers mark the site of a former Buddhist complex on the plain.

name: 喀什站
Kashgar Railway Station
introduction: 这里是南疆铁路和喀和铁路相接的车站。
The Southern Xinjiang Railway meets the line to Hotan at Kashgar station.

name: 新疆博物馆
Xinjiang Museum
introduction: 西北路的展厅收藏着新疆各地出土的器物与纺织品。
The galleries on Xibei Road hold objects and textiles excavated across Xinjiang.

name: 红山公园
Red Hill Park
introduction: 红山塔立在城市上方，塔下的步道穿过后来种植的林地。
Paths through planted woodland climb to the pagoda above the city.

name: 新疆国际大巴扎
Xinjiang International Grand Bazaar
introduction: 二道桥的市场街区围绕大巴扎展开。
The bazaar stands among the market streets of Erdaoqiao.

name: 乌鲁木齐站
Ürümqi Railway Station
introduction: 二宫旧站址如今汇集进出乌鲁木齐的客运列车。
Passenger trains now converge on the former site of Ergong station.

name: 布达拉宫
Potala Palace
introduction: 白宫与红宫沿红山的山脊层层升起。
The White and Red palaces rise in tiers along the ridge of Marpori.

name: 大昭寺
Jokhang Temple
introduction: 八廓街环绕大昭寺，街巷与寺院在这里相接。
The Barkhor circuit wraps around the Jokhang at the heart of old Lhasa.

name: 罗布林卡
Norbulingka
introduction: 拉萨西郊的园路将夏宫、池水与林地连在一起。
Garden paths connect summer palaces, pools and groves in western Lhasa.

name: 哲蚌寺
Drepung Monastery
introduction: 哲蚌寺的建筑依更丕乌孜山麓展开。
The halls of Drepung spread across the lower slopes west of Lhasa.

name: 东关清真大寺
Dongguan Mosque
introduction: 东关大街南侧，一条由大门通向礼拜堂的轴线贯穿院落。
A courtyard leads from Dongguan Street to the prayer hall in eastern Xining.

name: 塔尔寺
Kumbum Monastery
introduction: 塔尔寺的经院与殿堂分布在湟中山谷。
The colleges and halls of Kumbum follow the contours of a valley in Huangzhong.

name: 青海省博物馆
Qinghai Provincial Museum
introduction: 城西的博物馆陈列青海的考古发现与地方文化。
The museum in western Xining exhibits archaeology and material culture from Qinghai.

name: 西宁站
Xining Railway Station
introduction: 建国路的站台连接向西的高原线路和向东的兰青铁路。
At Jianguo Road, lines onto the plateau meet the railway east to Lanzhou.

name: 大召寺
Dazhao Temple
introduction: 呼和浩特旧城里，大召殿内的银佛为寺院留下了「银佛寺」的别称。
The silver Buddha in the main hall gave this old-city temple another name, the Silver Buddha Temple.

name: 席力图召
Xilitu Zhao
introduction: 席力图召与大召隔街相望，寺内留有多种文字的碑刻。
Across the street from Dazhao, inscriptions in several scripts survive at Xilitu Zhao.

name: 五塔寺
Five Pagoda Temple
introduction: 五座小塔在同一座石台上并立，成了慈灯寺最容易辨认的轮廓。
Five small pagodas on a single platform give Cideng Temple its familiar silhouette.

name: 内蒙古博物院新华东街旧馆
Inner Mongolia Museum, Xinhua East Street
introduction: 新华东街的旧馆曾以草原为线索，展出古生物化石与地方文物。
The former Xinhua East Street museum displayed fossils and historical objects in galleries devoted to the grasslands.

name: 圣索菲亚教堂
Saint Sophia Cathedral
introduction: 教堂的绿色穹顶高出道里街区的红砖墙。
A green dome rises above the red-brick walls in Harbin’s Daoli district.

name: 防洪纪念塔
Flood Control Monument
introduction: 在中央大街的尽头，纪念塔面向松花江。
At the river end of Central Street, the monument faces the Songhua.

name: 哈尔滨文庙
Harbin Confucian Temple
introduction: 南岗区的文庙由院落、殿宇与庭树组成。
Courtyards and ceremonial halls form the Confucian Temple in Nangang.

name: 哈尔滨站
Harbin Railway Station
introduction: 南岗的这座车站最初取名松花江站。
The early station in Nangang took its name from the Songhua River.

name: 沈阳故宫
Shenyang Imperial Palace
introduction: 大政殿与十王亭把盛京早期的宫廷格局保留在沈阳旧城中。
Dazheng Hall and the Ten Princes’ Pavilions preserve an early palace layout in Shenyang’s old city.

name: 清昭陵
Zhaoling Mausoleum
introduction: 昭陵在沈阳城北，陵道穿过今天的北陵公园。
The approach to Zhaoling runs through Beiling Park north of the old city.

name: 张氏帅府
Zhang Family Mansion
introduction: 帅府的三进四合院与青砖楼房，留下不同时期的生活空间。
Successive courtyards and a blue-brick mansion record different periods of the Zhang family residence.

name: 清福陵
Fuling Mausoleum
introduction: 福陵坐落在沈阳东北郊，陵道沿地势向上。
The approach to Fuling rises through the northeastern outskirts of Shenyang.

name: 大雁塔
Giant Wild Goose Pagoda
introduction: 大慈恩寺内的砖塔与玄奘译经的历史相连。
The brick pagoda at Daci’en Temple is closely associated with Xuanzang’s translation work.

name: 西安钟楼
Xi’an Bell Tower
introduction: 钟楼位于西安旧城的十字街心，它曾经站在另一处路口。
The Bell Tower stands at the old city’s central crossroads, some distance from its original site.

name: 西安城墙南门
Xi’an City Wall, South Gate
introduction: 地图落点在南门一带，城墙从这里向两侧环绕明清旧城。
The map marks the South Gate section of the walls encircling the Ming and Qing city.

name: 小雁塔
Small Wild Goose Pagoda
introduction: 荐福寺塔的层层密檐，在古长安城南留下细长的轮廓。
The close-set eaves of Jianfu Temple’s pagoda form a slim silhouette in southern Chang’an.

name: 黄鹤楼
Yellow Crane Tower
introduction: 黄鹤楼今天立在蛇山上，早先的楼址更靠近江岸。
Today’s Yellow Crane Tower stands on Snake Hill, inland from the original riverside site.

name: 武汉长江大桥
Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge
introduction: 铁轨与公路分层跨过江面，连接汉阳与武昌。
Railway and roadway cross the river on separate decks between Hanyang and Wuchang.

name: 湖北省博物馆
Hubei Provincial Museum
introduction: 东湖畔的展馆收藏着湖北各地出土的文物。
The museum beside East Lake holds finds excavated across Hubei.

name: 归元寺
Guiyuan Temple
introduction: 汉阳翠微路旁，归元寺的庭院里分布着殿堂与藏经阁。
Courtyards on Cuiwei Road in Hanyang link the halls and scripture library of Guiyuan Temple.

name: 栈桥
Zhanqiao Pier
introduction: 栈桥从青岛湾岸边伸入海中，尽头立着回澜阁。
Zhanqiao reaches into Qingdao Bay and ends at the Huilan Pavilion.

name: 圣弥厄尔教堂
Saint Michael’s Cathedral
introduction: 双塔从浙江路的坡地上升起，面向老城区的屋顶。
Twin towers rise above the sloping streets and rooftops around Zhejiang Road.

name: 青岛站
Qingdao Railway Station
introduction: 距离海湾不远的站房，把胶济铁路的终点引到旧城区。
Close to the bay, the station brought the Jiaozhou–Jinan railway into the old city.

name: 胶澳总督官邸
Former Governor’s Residence
introduction: 这座旧官邸建在信号山南麓，后来成为迎宾馆。
The former governor’s residence on the southern slope of Signal Hill later became a guesthouse.

name: 翠湖
Green Lake
introduction: 湖堤与小岛将翠湖分成数片相连的水面。
Causeways and small islands divide Green Lake into connected pools.

name: 云南陆军讲武堂
Yunnan Military Academy
introduction: 讲武堂的院落毗邻翠湖，长廊围合着操场。
Beside Green Lake, the academy buildings enclose the old parade ground.

name: 西南联大纪念碑
Southwest Associated University Monument
introduction: 旧校址上的石碑为战时在昆明办学的三所大学留下共同纪念。
A stone monument on the old campus recalls the three universities that shared a wartime home in Kunming.

name: 圆通寺
Yuantong Temple
introduction: 圆通山脚的寺院沿水池和殿堂展开。
Pools and temple halls occupy the foot of Yuantong Hill.

name: 陈家祠
Chen Clan Academy
introduction: 祠堂的屋脊、墙面与门扇，集中展现了岭南工匠的雕塑与装饰。
Ridge ornaments, carved doors and reliefs preserve the work of Lingnan craftspeople.

name: 镇海楼
Zhenhai Tower
introduction: 越秀山上的五层楼曾是广州北城墙的高点。
This five-storey tower on Yuexiu Hill once marked a high point of Guangzhou’s northern wall.

name: 中山纪念堂
Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall
introduction: 纪念堂坐落在原总统府旧址，以宽阔的屋顶覆盖集会大厅。
A broad roof spans the assembly hall on the site of the former presidential office.

name: 光孝寺
Guangxiao Temple
introduction: 光孝寺的院中留有南汉时期铸造的铁塔。
Iron pagodas from the Southern Han period survive in the courtyards of Guangxiao Temple.

name: 五公祠
Temple of the Five Lords
introduction: 祠、楼、泉井聚在海府路旁，纪念不同时代来到海南的人。
Halls, shrines and springs on Haifu Road commemorate figures who came to Hainan in different centuries.

name: 海瑞墓
Hai Rui’s Tomb
introduction: 海瑞墓园在海口城西，墓道与展室留下人们纪念这位明代官员的痕迹。
The burial grounds west of central Haikou commemorate the Ming official Hai Rui.

name: 海口站
Haikou Railway Station
introduction: 秀英区西部的车站与跨海铁路相接。
This station in western Xiuying connects Hainan’s railways to the cross-strait route.

name: 秀英炮台
Xiuying Fort
introduction: 秀英村后的小丘保留着清代海防建筑的遗迹。
A hill behind Xiuying village preserves the remains of a Qing coastal fort.
